retailexEasNotes.init: cd mobile && npx eas-cli@latest login && npx eas-cli@latest init
retailexEasNotes.projectId: eas init / eas build:configure CLI ile expo.extra.eas.projectId yazar; UUID uydurma — bu alan bağlanana kadar yoktur.
retailexEasNotes.ciAlign: GitHub Actions android-release.yml = kök npm run android:ci:build → debug APK. EAS profile debug ≈ aynı (assembleDebug, withoutCredentials). EAS preview = dahili imzalı APK. EAS production = Play AAB.
retailexEasNotes.profiles: mobile/eas.json → debug | preview | production. Ayrıntı: mobile/README.md#eas-build
